cards.title: ELI5: the chip, not the phone
items: A device tree lists the hardware for the kernel
This one lists the Exynos 7885 SoC and nothing else
The parts bolted onto the board aren't named here
So it describes the chip, not the whole phone

cards.title: What's on the SoC
items: 2x Cortex-A73 + 6x Cortex-A53, Mali GPU, ~2 GB RAM
Display, camera ISP, ABOX audio, video codecs
Wi-Fi/BT combo, USB, eMMC-style storage, modem/GNSS, FM
Power (PMU + ACPM) and the TEEGRIS secure world

cards.title: What's missing (the board layer)
items: No PMIC, charger or fuel-gauge chip
No camera image sensors or display panel named
An 8 MB keyword sweep found none of them

cards.title: Honest limits
items: Curated view; the full 170-node table is in the appendix
dtbo.img (the likely home of board nodes) not parsed
Buses are disabled here; children may be added at boot
The bootloader may rewrite the memory nodes
